compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen displays a "Shop" section where users can purchase items using a virtual currency called "CANDIES," with the user currently having 202 candies. The screen is divided into two main tabs: "Stickers shop" and "Shop," with the "Shop" tab currently selected.

Below the tabs, there is a list of available items for purchase, each with a name, release date, and cost in candies. The items listed include:

1. Checker - Released on Dec 6, 2016, costing 200 candies.
2. Christmas - Released on Dec 6, 2016, costing 200 candies.
3. Alice - Released on Nov 1, 2016, costing 200 candies.
4. Wave - Released on Nov 1, 2016, costing 200 candies.
